reports.title: CoreWeave Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: We are raising our full year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $13.0 billion to $13.3 billion.

We are also raising our full year 2026 adjusted operating income2 guidance to a range of $1.275 billion to $1.375 billion, representing a 26% increase at the midpoint compared with our prior guidance.
We continue to expect more than 1.85 gigawatts of active power at year-end.

We now expect full year 2026 capital expenditures of $37 billion to $39 billion, raising the low end of our prior guidance range of $35 billion to $39 billion. This is as a result of our expectation to deploy infrastructure and deliver it to customers sooner than planned.
We expect interest expense for Q4 2026 in the range of $1.05 to $1.15 billion.
Finally, we are raising our annualized run-rate revenue3 guidance to $20 billion to $21 billion to exit 2026.
